leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Zustand store with persist middleware in a Vue component
Configure the persist middleware to store data in localStorage
Initialize a persisted Zustand store with default state values
Bind persisted store state to reactive Vue component properties
Manipulate persisted state through store actions in Vue methods
Update persisted state across browser sessions using the middleware
Control rehydration behavior when the application loads persisted data
